infographic.title: Pressure Gauge Selection in 4 Steps
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four steps to select a pressure gauge: range, accuracy, materials and installation
steps: Choose a full scale about twice the normal working pressure.
Class 1.0 for process lines, 0.25 or better for test gauges.
Select wetted parts and case materials for the medium and site.
Add liquid filling, snubbers, siphons or seals where needed.
